request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:CAPTAIN

layers.text: Recolour only his skin (face, ears, arms, hands, chest): from yellow-olive to a fresh mid green, colour #4a8a3a, with lighter green #6faa55 on the face, nose, cheeks and chest and darker #326426 only as thin shading; the brown beard under his jaw becomes bare light green chin. Keep the open shouting mouth, tusks, eyes, horned tin helmet, cream fur mantle, yellow megaphone, straps, kilt, boots, pose, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
